meta.title: Adi Badash {'|'} Book Illustrator & Digital Artist
meta.description: Children's book illustration is a collaborative creation — built on communication, trust, and a style that fits your story.

promotion.signText: Click here for a free consultation

hero.tagline: The most important thing, in my view, when choosing an illustrator is collaboration and communication between both sides above all.
hero.hook:
When there is a genuine connection and open communication, a professional illustrator knows how to adapt stylistically and connect to the author's vision.

It's important to me that the process feels enjoyable and meaningful for both sides — because that's where the most beautiful results come from.
hero.invitation: If my illustrations and way of working resonate with you, I invite you to get in touch. I would love to take part in the process and share the excitement with you when the work comes to life.

workWith.label: Style matching
workWith.title: Matching illustration style and character to the story's needs
workWith.subtitle: When working with authors, we sit together, analyze and understand the nature of the story, the author's vision, and the feelings the illustrations need to convey.

emotional.title: Emotional stories
emotional.description: For stories with an emotional character, emphasis is placed on facial expressions, emotion, and dynamics between characters.

dreamy.title: Dreamy stories
dreamy.description: For stories with a dreamy character, the focus is on building a world and atmosphere that wrap the words and story and draw the reader into the world created for them.

process.label: Work stages
process.title: Work stages
process.subtitle: A clear, transparent, collaborative process — from the first conversation to the cover.

goal.title: Defining the goal
goal.description: The first thing we do together is an introductory conversation, to understand your vision, the visual world you are aiming for, and to align on the character of the illustrations and figures.

briefing.title: Briefing session
briefing.description: At the start of the project we meet together, go through the text, divide it into spreads, brainstorm ideas, and define the illustrations for each spread.

sketches.title: Sketches and black-and-white illustrations
sketches.description: After the illustrations are defined, sketches will be sent for concept approval, followed by black-and-white illustrations of the characters and interior spreads for composition approval.

color.title: Color stage
color.description: After the composition and black-and-white illustrations are approved, we move on to the exciting and enjoyable stage of coloring. At this stage, color illustrations will be sent, and changes and refinements to the color palette can be made.

touchups.title: Touch-ups
touchups.description: After the colors are approved, final touch-ups and refinements will be made to the interior illustrations.

cover.title: Cover
cover.description: We save the cover illustration for the end, because it is the face of the book, and the best ideas often come during the working process.

services.label: Illustration packages
services.title: Illustration packages
services.subtitle: Choose the package that fits the stage your project is in.

illustration.title: Illustration
illustration.description: Book illustration after receiving the text divided into spreads, with each spread forming a double page. At the end of the process you will receive high-quality files for further graphic work and cover design.

illustrationDesign.title: Illustration + graphic design
illustrationDesign.description: Text division into spreads, book illustration, cover design, text integration, and preparation of print-ready files.

gallery.label: Portfolio
gallery.title: Selected work
gallery.subtitle: Browse by project type — a glimpse into visual languages shaped for story, commission, and brand.
